concept: Describe an event or place (a festival, a restaurant entrance, a family crest) and Claude AI matches it to the real chochin paper-lantern tradition it belongs to, explaining shape, regional style, and the calligraphy conventions painted on them.

Describe a wish for your shop, home, or venture and Claude AI matches it to the real maneki-neko (beckoning cat) tradition - which paw, which color, which pose - explaining the Edo-era folklore and shopkeeper etiquette behind each variant.
